content.summary: Collect up to two typed contributions per person and share each successfully acknowledged item in accepted order.
content.setup: The host supplies eligible actors and resolved contribution/response/voting windows. A filled contribution limit does not close its window; the host closes it at the declared time or explicitly.
content.participant: Submit up to two text, image or audio contributions in total. Later, claim a piece other than your own, read/play it, and acknowledge if it should be shared with attribution.
content.completion: Iterate only finally eligible accepted items, in acceptance order. A claim or acknowledgment timeout skips publication. If no non-author reader is possible, that item skips immediately.
content.access: Private contributions remain with their author until an explicit consumer shares them. A claimed typed item and attribution go to its reader; successful acknowledgment explicitly shares that actual item. Voting publishes eligible candidates and authors on entry; public results do not expose private individual ballots.

provenance.rights: Authors retain rights to their contributions; this definition grants no media rights.
